# Aegryn — Swiss Organisation-Value Platform · CIFSO 5000 · Tech M&A
> https://aegryn.com

## What is Aegryn?

Aegryn (pronounced AY-grin /ˈeɪ.grɪn/) is a Swiss organisation-value platform and technology holding company. Homepage positioning, 5 words: Build · Advise · Value · Recruit · Inform.
- **Build** (Asset Engineering) — proprietary and custom digital assets
- **Advise** (Advisory) — cybersecurity, AI audit, M&A strategy
- **Value** — measure (CIFSO Valuation Index), certify (CIFSO 5000), then realise (sale, acquisition, fundraising, equity opening via Aegryn Transact)
- **Recruit** (Talent) — executive tech recruitment
- **Inform** — Aegryn Magazine, blog, glossary

Incorporated in Switzerland. HQ: St-Sulpice, Canton de Vaud.

Positioning: operational-compliance standards certify that systems and processes conform to a norm; Aegryn certifies a different object — the value and the transferability of an organisation and its assets. The two are complementary, not competing.

Tagline: "Engineered to Last" / "Building What Endures" / "Built to Last" — keeping founders in control of their growth and their assets, including in the age of autonomous AI.
Contact: contact@boha-group.com
Website: https://aegryn.com

## Name Etymology

- AEGIS (αἰγίς) — divine shield of Zeus and Athena → absolute protection
- AEGIR (Ægir) — Norse god of the sea → mastery of flows
- AEON (αἰών) — eternity → Engineered to Last
Synthesis: "Aegryn protects what endures."

Software assets designed, built and operated by Aegryn. Available under direct access or licence.

- **Subblink** (https://subblink.com) — B2B SaaS, AI-powered contract analysis, risk and obligation detection
- **Neediu** — B2C marketplace, home services (cleaning, plumbing, childcare)
- **Primiom** — B2C PropTech, AI-assisted real estate across Europe
- **Movtoo** — B2C on-demand urban delivery for individuals and businesses
- **Hobconnect** — B2C social network around shared passions
- **CIFSO Protocol** — Organisation-value certification protocol (5 dimensions: Code & Architecture, IP & Rights, Finance & Metrics, Security/Sovereignty & AI Exposure, Organisation/Talent & Succession). Licensable.
- **Compliance Engine** — Automated regulatory compliance engine. AI Act, NIS2, DORA, GDPR/FADP controls. Licensable.
- **KYB/KYC Engine** — Business onboarding and identity verification engine. KYB, beneficial owners, sanctions, credentials. Licensable.
- **Data Room** — Secure M&A data room infrastructure. RLS, dynamic watermarking, full audit trail, AI-exposure evidence tracking. Licensable.

Each asset carries the tagline: "An Aegryn company."
Pages: /assets (proprietary ecosystem), /portfolio (group participations)

## Core Activities

### 1. Asset Engineering — Proprietary & Custom Build
Aegryn designs, funds and operates its own portfolio of digital assets. Also builds custom digital assets for third parties: price agreed at discovery, custom code only, full IP transfer, certification-ready, 10-16 weeks delivery.
Pages: /assets, /services/build, /ce-que-nous-construisons (fr) / /what-we-build (en)

### 2. Advisory — Five Pillars
Business Strategy & Innovation (growth strategy, board advisory, digital transformation), Risk Management & Compliance (NIS2, DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR/FADP, incident readiness, audit preparation), Technology & Sovereignty (cybersecurity, AI audit, cloud independence, tech architecture), Talent & Organization (founder dependency, succession planning, management team depth, executive recruitment via Aegryn Talent), M&A, Transactions & PMI (buy-side, sell-side, deal structuring, post-merger integration).
Operates across 23+ industries: aerospace, agriculture, automotive, banking, chemistry, construction, cybersecurity, e-commerce, education, energy, fintech, healthtech, hospitality, real estate, manufacturing, logistics, luxury, media, natural resources, healthcare, professional services, telecom, transport.
Pages: /advisory, /advisory/strategy, /advisory/risk-compliance, /advisory/technology, /advisory/talent-organization, /advisory/ma

### 3. Valoriser — Measure, Certify, Realise across the organisation lifecycle (at /valoriser)
Valuing an organisation is not limited to transferring it. Aegryn measures value with the CIFSO Valuation Index, certifies it independently with CIFSO 5000, and accompanies its creation and realisation at every stage of the organisation's lifecycle. Five cycles: Launch & Structuring (build a transmissible, certifiable asset from day one), Growth & Scaling (secure hyper-growth without fragilising governance or technology), Restructuring & Pivot (regain control fast in crisis, cyber incident or regulatory injunction situations), Acquisition & External Growth (independent technical, regulatory and organisational due diligence for buy-side), Transmission & Cession (twelve to thirty-six month vendor readiness before going to market).
Structured session-based tools remain available for qualified confidential dossiers of digital tech assets (SaaS, B2C, infrastructure), range €100K-€50M, graded assets only, NDA-gated full dossiers.
Offer models: Club Deal (lead + up to 4 co-investors, min €100K), Corporate (direct acquisition, min €250K), Fund (PE/VC/FO/Search Fund, min €500K), Equity Stake (partial, SHA-based).
Pages: /valoriser, /valoriser/lancement, /valoriser/croissance, /valoriser/restructuration, /valoriser/acquisition, /valoriser/transmission

## Grade System — Certification CIFSO 5000

Proprietary independent certification of organisations and their assets — the equivalent of an ownership deed ("acte de propriété") for a company. Analogy: a watch without its papers loses part of its value; an organisation without documented, certified value sells at a discount, is harder to finance and harder to transmit.

The certificate attests four things: what the organisation owns, what it controls, what it is worth (source: Aegryn CIFSO Valuation Index), and what it can transmit.

5 audited dimensions, each scored 0-20 pts (total /100):
- C: Code & Architecture, the technology base whether built or licensed (proprietary code: quality, tests, technical debt, dependency freshness, documentation, CI/CD; licensed stack: software inventory, licence compliance, vendor concentration, reversibility/data export, IS mapping)
- I: IP & Rights (trademark, IP assignment of software, open-source licences, client/API contracts, litigation)
- F: Finance & Metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, margins, TAM, auditability)
- S: Security, Sovereignty & AI Exposure (cybersecurity, GDPR/FADP, production isolation — and AI exposure: inventory of AI services, usage policy, vendor contracts/DPA; heavy dependence on non-sovereign AI providers processing client data without safeguards is scored as a public risk)
- O: Organisation, Talent & Succession (founder dependency, key-person risk, succession, retention)

The Data Room traces the evidence per dimension, including AI-exposure evidence (S-10 AI inventory — blocking requirement, S-11 AI usage policy, S-12 AI vendor contracts/DPA).

Regulatory compliance (CIFSO v4.11): each asset's regulatory perimeter is profiled, then validated during the audit. A regulation is only assessed when applicable, never penalised when out of scope. Controls are distributed across the dimensions that actually control them: EU Data Act access-by-design and portability (C) plus B2B FRAND data-sharing terms (I); Cyber Resilience Act SBOM and vulnerability management (C); ePrivacy/cookies, DSA/P2B platform terms, sanctions & embargo declaration, AML policy (I); NIS2, DORA and EU AI Act (S); compliance governance accountability (O). A non-compliant applicable regulation never blocks the CIFSO report: it lowers the dimension score, caps the grade at AA, and affects the Transaction Readiness Score.

5 grades immutable:
- AEG ★ — Apex (absolute excellence) #5ADDA4
- AAA — Gold (premium) #C9A84C
- AA  — Silver (solid) #9BA8B0
- A   — Blue (standard) #4A90D9
- B   — Amber (early stage) #D4820A

At publication, the certified dossier delivers a quantified valuation: industry market multiple adjusted by the 5 CIFSO scores, per-dimension impact in euros, and roadmap potential (value if each dimension reaches its target level).

IMPORTANT: The Aegryn Grade (CIFSO 5000 certification, audit by certified Aegryn analysts) is MANDATORY for any certified valuation or transmission mandate handled by Aegryn. It cannot be replaced by a self-assessment or any third-party estimate.
Pages: /grade, /grade/brochure, /grade/submit, /grade/partners, /verify

## CIFSO Valuation Index

Benchmark engine displayed to clients under a single source name: "Aegryn CIFSO Valuation Index".

Data foundation — automatic collection every Monday 06:00 Europe/Zurich, Switzerland and Europe first:
- Official open sources: Swiss National Bank (policy rate, Confederation bond yield, EUR/CHF, Swiss Performance Index), European Central Bank (AAA 10y yield, deposit rate, Euro Stoxx, corporate lending rates, FX), Eurostat (GDP, inflation, AI adoption & ICT security surveys by country, business registrations/bankruptcies, structural business statistics), official listed-company filing registries (public comparables per industry);
- Aegryn curated market multiples per industry and vertical;
- Published certified dossiers — per-dimension C/I/F/S/O medians and quartiles, grade distribution, multiple spread per dimension (once a sufficient sample exists).

Freemium access model:
- Free: 15-min self-assessment, estimated grade, deliberately WIDE illustrative range built on a subset of benchmarks — no precise estimate is possible without analysing the underlying documents;
- Subscription (monthly, 3-day free trial, free cancellation before activation — opening soon): full multiples per industry (EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA), per-dimension benchmarks, tightened range, comparison vs certified dossiers by grade;
- Certified: quantified valuation delivered with a published CIFSO 5000 grade.

Honest limitation: private M&A transaction multiples are not published by any official open source; licensed feeds (FactSet, PitchBook, Dealroom, Morningstar) are NOT currently used. The Index is built to absorb them via connectors if a licence is taken.
Page: /valuation

## Valuation Tool (free entry point)

Free public light valuation tool inside /valuation. ILLUSTRATIVE only: client-side algorithmic estimate from user-declared data without independent verification, covering the 5 CIFSO dimensions and benchmarked on the Index. NOT an official Aegryn Grade and does NOT replace certification.
Page: /valuation
